articles.headline: Indian Rupee Bulls Return After 18 Months
articles.brief: The Indian rupee has seen a notable resurgence with bulls returning after 18 months, while rupiah bears tighten their grip amid fluctuating regional currency dynamics and shifting foreign exchange market pressures across emerging Asian economies.

articles.headline: US Tariff Uncertainty Threatens India Export Edge
articles.brief: Trade bodies warn that proposed US reciprocal tariffs and Section 301 duties could squeeze India's export edge over regional Asian rivals, despite recent strong merchandise export growth figures reported for October.

articles.headline: Centre Calls Special Three-Day Parliament Session
articles.brief: The Indian government has requested a special three-day sitting of Parliament starting November 30 to take up essential legislative business, fueling widespread political debate surrounding women's reservation quotas and upcoming delimitation bills.

articles.headline: Britain Calls Up Reservists Amid Russia Threat
articles.brief: In a historic move responding to shifting security landscapes and rising tensions with Russia in Europe, Britain is contacting 100,000 military reservists to evaluate skills and define roles for national security.

articles.headline: Health Ministry Sets Strict Autism Trial Rules
articles.brief: India's health ministry has mandated insurance coverage, banned administrative fees, and enforced strict 90-day clearance rules for autism stem cell clinical trials to eliminate unproven procedures sold as routine medical care.

articles.headline: Apple Pulls MiniMax AI Chatbot From Store
articles.brief: Apple has removed the MiniMax AI chatbot from its App Store following growing child safety concerns regarding automated content generation and platform governance frameworks.

articles.headline: Gukesh Ahead on Time in World Chess Match
articles.brief: D. Gukesh holds a time advantage over Javokhir Sindarov after 20 moves in Game 3 of the World Chess Championship match in Geneva, keeping the youngest title match in history closely contested.

articles.headline: OPEC+ Likely to Roll Over Q1 Oil Targets
articles.brief: OPEC+ sources indicate the coalition is likely to roll over existing oil output targets for the first quarter as persistent capacity disputes and market balancing efforts continue to influence global crude supplies.

articles.headline: Meta Battles Political Storm in India
articles.brief: Meta is facing intense political scrutiny and legal challenges in India as the Congress party files lawsuits and stages widespread protests regarding platform policies and electoral integrity.

articles.headline: 85,000 Indians Exit UK as Net Migration Falls
articles.brief: Recent migration statistics reveal that approximately 85,000 Indian nationals exited the United Kingdom over a 12-month period, topping all nationalities as overall net migration numbers experience a sharp decline.

articles.headline: Automatic GST Registration Cancellations From Dec 1
articles.brief: India's tax administration is rolling out automated GST registration cancellations starting December 1, designed to drastically reduce administrative bottlenecks and expedite business exits from the tax system.

articles.headline: Jensen Huang Foundation Gains $2.3B in a Day
articles.brief: A major surge in Nvidia shares has driven significant financial gains for CEO Jensen Huang's philanthropic foundation, pushing its total valuation to $9.7 billion following targeted tech and academic investments.

articles.headline: Sindhu Eyes Historic Uber Cup Triumph
articles.brief: Star Indian shuttler PV Sindhu has expressed strong determination to guide the national team to victory at the 2028 Uber Cup, following the announcement that India will host the premier international badminton tournament.

articles.headline: Indian Court Tightens Food Labelling Rules
articles.brief: An Indian court has issued directives tightening packaged food labelling proposals, mandating that global food conglomerates end perceived double standards regarding nutritional disclosures and safety standards.

articles.headline: IBM Gives H-1B Workers Three Weeks to Move
articles.brief: Technology giant IBM has reportedly given affected H-1B visa and green card holders a strict three-week deadline to relocate within the United States or face separation from the company by year's end.
